=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/scripts/claude_fix_claim.py:61-78 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `clean_hold_reason()` strips HTML-comment openers but not all comment delimiters, so some inputs leave fragments such as `<!------>` or a dangling `-->` in the comment body.
  WHY: The opener fragment is described as benign, but a downstream comment scanner could mis-frame text after a dangling closer.
- .claude/scripts/stale_sessions.py:170 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `SOURCE_URL_PATTERN` can match `https://github.com/.git` with an empty repository capture, leading to malformed GitHub API paths.
  WHY: The malformed path is rejected and the session is kept, but the source URL produces an empty repo value.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:922-938 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: If obtaining the merge base fails or yields no value, `claude_fixer_judge_fix_count()` falls back to counting all PR commits, potentially counting `[judge-fix]` commits that should be excluded.
  WHY: The inflated count can exhaust the judge-fix cap and send the judge to its terminal path before the budget is actually exhausted.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:922-937 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The zero-match `grep -c` handling in `claude_fixer_judge_fix_count()` is currently correct but fragile to future changes in the placement of `|| true`.
  WHY: The current function returns the correct count, but moving `|| true` outside the function could change how a zero-match result is handled.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_claude_fixer_handoff.sh:~301-308 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `claude_fixer_clean_ledger` requires a no-findings placeholder to match exactly, so trailing whitespace or indentation can cause a clean review round to be treated as having findings.
  WHY: The round may be handed off as `kind=findings` without a finding payload, stalling the PR.
- .claude/scripts/stale_sessions.py:209-243 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `_load_document()` can abort on wrapper text it cannot parse or validate, including a result-like object rejected by `_page()` or a brace-prefixed non-JSON line.
  WHY: Instead of continuing past unrelated or structurally invalid wrapper text, it can reject the input and exit 2, preventing the pickup wake from producing its report.
- .claude/scripts/stale_sessions.py:498-503 | severity=low | confidence=[1]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `record_stalls()` pops `permission_mode` in two passes, with the later pop being a no-op when the earlier pass has already removed it.
  WHY: This does not cause a runtime failure; the field is removed from the visible output in both paths.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~891-934 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When the marker fetch fails in the `claude_fixer_judge_head` branch, the run can proceed with reviewers while retaining a stale `SKIP_REASON` and emitting no `AUTOFIX_GATE_SKIP` log line.
  WHY: Downstream accounting can see a misleading skip reason, and the run log does not show why reviewers were not skipped.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_claude_fixer_handoff.sh:158-182 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The paginated comment fetch can make an extra empty-list REST request when the last page contains exactly 100 comments.
  WHY: Long-lived PRs can incur extra REST round trips in both the function and the gate fetch.
- .claude/scripts/check_in_status.py:267-276 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A malformed or missing PR head SHA is handled as a retry rather than a differentiated permanent failure.
  WHY: A permanently malformed response can cause the check to repeat on every poll without backoff.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_claude_fixer_judge.sh:107-112 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Rejection-comment extraction can treat a marker line in quoted or pasted comment text as the actual marker.
  WHY: A comment containing the marker in a code block or other text may be selected as a rejection marker.
- .claude/scripts/stale_sessions.py:357-366 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The API cache in `classify()` is local to one invocation and cannot be reused across pickup wakes.
  WHY: The next wake re-fetches the same PR or issue state; the review notes this is a dead-code performance concern in the current mode.
- .claude/scripts/check_in_status.py:795-818 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The module docstring does not document the additive `retry_after_minutes` field included in every JSON line.
  WHY: A consumer relying on the module docstring alone may fail to thread the field through and use the old 60-minute default for held heads.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
